description: This file contains implementation for Google GenAI content generation, including setup, synchronous and asynchronous functions, and handlers for streaming and non-streaming responses. It defines classes, helper functions, and integrates with external modules for configuration, logging, and HTTP handling.

classes.name: GenerateContentSetupResult
classes.description: Holds the setup result for a generate content call, including model info, request body, provider config, and logging.

classes.name: GenerateContentHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for mocking responses and setting up generate content calls.

methods.name: mock_generate_content_response
methods.description: Returns a mock response dictionary for testing.

methods.name: setup_generate_content_call
methods.description: Prepares and returns the setup result for a generate content request, including request body and configuration.
